name: Forge
author: acobrerosf
description: Laravel Forge server health and deployment status in the Omarchy bar, across every organization you have a token for, with one-key deploys.

barWidget.description: Watch Laravel Forge servers and site deployments across organizations, and deploy from the bar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Forge allows 60 requests a minute per Forge account. One tick costs one request per organization, plus one per server when deployment watching is on.

schema.label: Watch deployments
schema.description: Also fetch each server's sites and their latest deployment. Off means server health only, at one request per tick.

schema.label: Notify on deployment changes
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a deployment finishes or fails.

schema.label: Organizations to show
schema.description: Leave empty to show every organization set up with `omarchy-forge add`. Name one slug, or a comma-separated list, to narrow this copy of the widget to those.

schema.label: Dashboard URL template
schema.description: Where the 'open in Forge' action points. {org} is the organization slug, {server} the server slug (use {serverId} for the numeric id), {site} the site id. The {site} segment is dropped for a server row.
